integrity.finite_checks: Exhaustive finite checks corroborate the proof for eight \((p,b)\) pairs; they do not replace the general proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Self-contained parameterization of all endomorphisms followed by an exact valuation count.

scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only \(A=C_p\oplus C_{p^b}\) with \(b\ge2\) and the fixed subgroup \(A[p]\).
The count does not classify other fixed-subgroup types or groups with more invariant factors.
The full text of Camina and Collins (1974) was not accessible in the inspected record; this remains a literature-overlap risk.
title: Type-resolved fixed-point count for rank-two abelian p-groups
